tools.name: tavzio_list_resources
tools.description: List the business's API resources, with whether each is readable, writable or deletable and the scopes it needs. The list is not filtered by this key's scopes: a call without the scope returns 403. Call this first; it returns the current list instead of a fixed one. Tavzio API: GET /api/v1.

tools.name: tavzio_list_records
tools.description: List records of one resource for the business that owns the key (for example orders, menu or tables), paged. Returns data and pagination (limit, offset, total). Tavzio API: GET /api/v1/{resource}.

tools.name: tavzio_get_record
tools.description: Get one record of a resource by id, for example one order with its status and total. Tavzio API: GET /api/v1/{resource}/{id}.

tools.name: tavzio_update_order_status
tools.description: Move one order to a new status: pending, preparing, ready, completed or cancelled. This uses the same status rules as the Tavzio dashboard and can start kitchen or POS actions. Order creation is not available through this server. Tavzio API: PATCH /api/v1/orders/{id}/status.
